score_meaning: p_jamming and p_spoofing are model scores, calibrated (isotonic) against the system's own training labels (weak rules and simulated attacks) on its validation day: of cells scored 0.8, about 8 in 10 carried those labels in testing. They are not validated probabilities of real interference. In practice almost every cell scores below 0.1 or above 0.9; on hand-labeled cells, scores of 0.9 or more were interference 97% of the time and scores below 0.1 were 7% of the time (a third of the time over the Black Sea). The label uses the uncalibrated score at the threshold given.

reviewed_score_bands.meaning: Share of hand-reviewed cells in each score band that the reviewer called interference (jamming, spoofing or both).

notice: Research output. Not for navigation, flight planning or any operational decision. Not an attribution of interference to any party.
